name: Counters
summary: Numbers that move: tallies, totals, scores, seats left, hit points.
description:
Groups of named numbers that people in an initiative step up and down.

Each counter keeps its own step, its own floor and ceiling, its color, and the value a reset puts it back to. Counters show as a number, a progress bar or a segmented clock. Reset one counter, or the whole group at once.

A counter linked to a task holds the task up until it reaches its max. Counter groups are shared, tagged, linked, commented on, archived and exported like every other tool.

images.alt: An initiative's Counters tab with two counter groups as cards, each previewing its counters in their colors: hit points as progress bars, tallies as numbers and a long rest as a segmented clock.
A counter group's counters as a grid of colored cards, each with its name, its count and minus and plus buttons, drawn as a progress bar, a number or a segmented clock.
A counter full screen: its count, 38, large in the middle, with wide minus and plus buttons along the bottom.

versions.release_notes: Brings the Counter board: one counter as the headline, its progress toward the goal, and the rest of its group charted alongside. Needs an Initiative serving plug-in API 11.2.
